tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had filed an appeal before the Hon’ble High Court of Bombay against an order passed by the Income Tax Appellant Tribunal (ITAT) on certain disallowances and additions set aside to Assessing Officer pertaining to the erstwhile Mahindra Trucks and Buses Limited (since merged with Mahindra Two Wheelers Limited which in turn merged with the Company) for Assessment Year 2013-14.
tax_litigation.status: The Assessing Officer in Order giving effect to ITAT order decided the issues set aside in favour of the Company and hence, the appeal filed before Hon'ble Bombay High Court was withdrawn by the Company. The Hon’ble High Court of Bombay vide its Order dated 11th March 2026, has dismissed the appeal as withdrawn.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: An authorisation dated 26th December 2024, for initiating inspection / search proceedings u/s 67 of CGST Act, 2017 was issued by Additional Commissioner (ST), Intelligence-I (FAC), Chennai-6 on the Company. The same was shown to the Company’s officials on 27th December 2024 at around 12.15 p.m. wherein, the department have sought records related to below observations for the period F-19 till December, 2024 for conducting further inquiries: (i) Transactions relating to supply of goods or services including payment under Reverse Charge; (ii) Input Tax Credit claims by the Company.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received orders dated 24th March 2026 and 30th March 2026. Following points are forthcoming from these orders: (i) It has been mentioned that these inquiries were inspection proceedings rather than "search" proceedings. Accordingly, such inspection proceedings do not necessitate disclosure under SEBI Regulations. (ii) The issues covered by the inspection proceedings have been concluded and dropped in entirety in favor of the Company for FY 19-20 & FY 20-21. The Company is expecting similar outcome for future period under litigation as well.

operating_notes.text: M&M executed a Novation and Amendment Agreement transferring Manulife's life insurance JV rights to Manulife Holdings (Bermuda) Limited.
M&M acquired an additional 28.03% stake in Carnot Technologies Private Limited for ₹6.72 crore, increasing its equity holding to 80.72%.
MEAL allotted equity shares upon conversion of CCPS held by BII India, BII Plc, and Temasek, valuing MEAL at ₹40,425 crore and reducing M&M's stake from 99.99% to 92.45%.
April 2026 total auto sales stood at 94,627 vehicles (up 14% YoY) and domestic tractor sales at 46,404 units (up 20% YoY).
M&M recommended a final dividend of ₹33 per share for FY26.
M&M reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹54,982 Cr and PAT of ₹4,668 Cr.
M&M maintained #1 SUV revenue market share at 25.3% in FY26.
M&M tractor market share reached a highest-ever 43.6% in FY26.
Mahindra Electric achieved PBIT positive status in Q4FY26 at ₹245 crores including contract manufacturing.
April 2026 total sales stood at 92,631 units, up 12.6% YoY.
MOICML sold its remaining 3.58% stake in CIE Automotive S.A for EUR 126 million, fully exiting the associate.
Mahindra Manulife Insurance Limited, a 50:50 life insurance JV with Manulife Holdings (Bermuda) Limited, was incorporated with ₹1 Cr paid-up capital; each partner subscribed ₹50 lakh.
May 2026: total vehicle sales 99,636 units (+20% YoY); domestic UVs 58,021 (+11%), 3-wheelers 12,536 (+89%), exports 5,000 (+37%).
May 2026: domestic tractor sales 47,845 units (+23% YoY), exports 1,850 (+7%); management cites timely Rabi harvest completion and favourable farmer terms of trade.
May 2026: Trucks & Buses (MTBD+SML) 3,129 units (+18% YoY); management flags elevated input costs and higher diesel prices as CV headwinds.
Aerostructures order book at $1.2 billion, with $600 million won in the last year.
Mahindra Finance loan book at ₹1,50,000 crore, with 83% wheels and 17% non-wheels.
Farm machinery revenue for Q1FY27 was ₹370 crore.

timeline.summary: M&M executed a novation and amendment agreement transferring Manulife's life insurance JV obligations to Manulife Holdings (Bermuda) Limited.
Mahindra & Mahindra acquired an additional 28.03% stake in subsidiary Carnot Technologies Private Limited for ₹6.72 crore.
M&M announced the conversion of investor CCPS in subsidiary Mahindra Electric Automobile Limited (MEAL) at a valuation of ₹40,425 crore, diluting its stake to 92.45%.
Mahindra & Mahindra reported a 14% growth in total auto sales to 94,627 units and a 20% growth in domestic tractor sales to 46,404 units for April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹54,981.91 Cr (+29.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4,667.57 Cr (+41.6% YoY).
M&M held its Q4FY26 analyst meet, outlining FY27 mid-to-high teen SUV growth targets and reporting FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹17,099 Cr (+35% YoY).
Mahindra & Mahindra filed the audio-video recording link for its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 5, 2026.
M&M hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 5, 2026, outlining strong EV profitability, capacity expansions, and mid-to-high teen SUV growth targets for FY27.
Mahindra & Mahindra reported total sales of 92,631 units in April 2026
On 14th May 2026, M&M announced that its subsidiary MOICML sold its remaining 3.58% stake in CIE Automotive S.A for EUR 126 million, exiting the associate.

On 30 May 2026, M&M said Mahindra Manulife Insurance Limited, its 50:50 life insurance JV with Manulife Holdings (Bermuda) Limited, was incorporated with ₹1 Cr paid-up capital, each partner subscribing ₹50 lakh.
On 1 June 2026, M&M reported May 2026 total vehicle sales of 99,636 units (+20% YoY), domestic UVs of 58,021 (+11%) and domestic tractors of 47,845 (+23%).
Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. cancels participation in Morgan Stanley India Investment Forum 2026 keynote on June 2, 2026, in Mumbai.
Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. participated in BOFA 2026 India Conference on 2nd June 2026, presenting Q4F26 Analyst Meet deck.

Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd’s **Sailesh Kumar Daga** (FCS) attended Nomura Investment Forum Asia 2026 in Singapore on **June 2–3, 2026**, presenting Q4FY26 slides without disclosing unpublished price-sensitive info.
M&M held its Q1FY27 earnings call on July 30, 2026, reporting 34% PAT growth, 23% ROE, and outlining capacity expansion plans and margin recovery expectations.
M&M diluted its stake in NDET from 72.07% to 49.63%, resulting in NDET ceasing to be a step-down subsidiary.
